products.name: Bananas, Bunch
products.description: Bananas are a versatile addition to your kitchen. Slice them over your morning cereal for a nutritious start to the day or blend them into a smoothie for a quick, refreshing beverage. These bananas come in a convenient bunch, making it easy to keep your fruit bowl stocked. Their natural sweetness and soft texture make them a favourite for snacks and baking. Enjoy the convenience of having fresh bananas on hand for various uses throughout the week.

products.name: Organic Bananas, Bunch
products.description: Sold by the bunch.Average bunch has 6-8 bananas. Bananas are typically 6-10 inches long and have a green peel when unripe. They taste best when the peel turns yellow and is speckled with dark spots.

products.name: Plantains, Single
products.description: Plantains are larger than regular bananas, with thicker skin and less sugar. They are typically cooked when green and have a mild flavour that is similar to squash.

products.name: Green Seedless Grapes
products.description: Bright, juicy, and refreshingly crisp, Autumn Crisp® Green Seedless Grapes are a go-to for easy, everyday snacking. Each bite has a yummy, sweet flavour with a satisfying crunch that makes them hard to put down. Seedless and fuss-free, they’re perfect for tossing into lunchboxes or adding to fruit salads. They're also great for serving on a charcuterie board with cheeses, meats, and crackers when you're hosting, or eating straight from the bag.

products.name: Red Seedless Grapes
products.description: A product of South Africa, Sweet Celebration Red Seedless Grapes are temptingly sweet and distinctly crisp. Each bite delivers a juicy burst of flavour with a firm texture that makes them satisfying to snack on. Seedless and easy to enjoy, they’re perfect for adding to your lunchboxes, fruit platters, salads, and more. Serve them on a charcuterie board with cheeses, meats, and crackers when you're hosting.

products.name: Blue Grapes
products.description: Grapes are a type of berry fruit with a leathery covering and a fleshy inside. They grow in clusters and can be crimson, black, dark blue, yellow, green, orange, and pink.

products.name: Red Seedless Watermelon
products.description: Watermelons come in a variety of shapes and colours, either with seeds or not. They are all sweet and juicy with a crisp flesh and watery texture. Sliced watermelon tastes great on its own, or you can toss watermelon cubes with some feta cheese and fresh mint for a summer salad.

products.name: Cantaloupe
products.description: Average weight is 3 lb.Cantaloupes have a greyish-beige skin with a raised netting overtop. The flesh is pale orange, juicy, and sweet. When ripe, cantaloupes are fragrant and yield to pressure at the blossom end. Remove the seeds and cube for a fruit salad or slice and wrap with prosciutto and mint for a refreshing summer salad.

products.name: Avocado
products.description: Avocados have a pebbly skin that turns from dark green to near black when ripe. Cut lengthwise, twist to separate the halves, and scoop out the creamy, pale green flesh for guacamole (lemon juice will keep the flesh from discolouring) and smoothies, or add sliced avocado to salad or a BLT sandwich.

products.name: Blueberries 1 pint
products.description: Blueberries range in colour from a deep purple-blue to a blue-black, both with a silvery sheen called bloom. Sweeten your morning by sprinkling blueberries on your cereal or pancakes, or add blueberries to a spinach salad with pecans and blue cheese.

products.name: Blueberries Half Pint
products.description: Blueberries range in colour from a deep purple-blue to a blue-black, both with a silvery sheen called bloom. Sweeten your morning by sprinkling blueberries on your cereal or pancakes, or add blueberries to a spinach salad with pecans and blue cheese.

products.name: Raspberries Half Pint
products.description: Raspberries are delicate fruit with bright red drupelets that connect to each other around a hollow central core. Their flavour is sweet but can also be tart if they aren’t quite ripe. Add them to your morning cereal, smoothie, or yogurt, or indulge with raspberries topped with cream and chocolate shavings.

products.name: Raspberry Pint
products.description: Raspberries are delicate fruit with bright red drupelets that connect to each other around a hollow central core. Their flavour is sweet but can also be tart if they aren’t quite ripe. Add them to your morning cereal, smoothie, or yogurt, or indulge with raspberries topped with cream and chocolate shavings.

products.name: Strawberries 1LB
products.description: Strawberries vary in colour, shape, and size but their flavour is distinctively sweet. They are topped with a hull of green leaves and are speckled with seeds on the surface. Enjoy yours in classic desserts like strawberry shortcake and strawberry-rhubarb pie, or add them to your next spinach salad with some crumbled goat cheese .

products.name: Strawberries 2LB
products.description: Strawberries vary in colour, shape, and size but their flavour is distinctively sweet. They are topped with a hull of green leaves and are speckled with seeds on the surface. Enjoy yours in classic desserts like strawberry shortcake and strawberry-rhubarb pie, or add them to your next spinach salad with some crumbled goat cheese.

products.name: Blackberries Half Pint
products.description: Blackberries range in colour from dark purple to black, and generally the more intense the colour, the sweeter the taste. Blackberries are great in smoothies and salads and can easily be made into jam, or use yours for a blackberry apple pie and enjoy with ice cream.

products.name: Lemon
products.description: Lemons have a bright yellow peel and can vary in size depending on the variety. This citrus fruit produces a tart, acidic juice that will add flavour to your salad dressings, beverages, and marinades. Lemon juice and rinds are also versatile ingredients for baking everything from cookies and cakes to a classic lemon meringue pie.

products.name: Lemons, 2 lb Bag
products.description: Lemons have a bright yellow peel and can vary in size depending on the variety. This citrus fruit produces a tart, acidic juice that will add flavour to your salad dressings, beverages, and marinades. Lemon juice and rinds are also versatile ingredients for baking everything from cookies and cakes to a classic lemon meringue pie.

products.name: Lemons, 2 lb Bag
products.description: Lemons have a bright yellow peel and can vary in size depending on the variety. This citrus fruit produces a tart, acidic juice that will add flavour to your salad dressings, beverages, and marinades. Lemon juice and rinds are also versatile ingredients for baking everything from cookies and cakes to a classic lemon meringue pie.

products.name: Limes
products.description: Limes are shaped like lemons but a little smaller in size. They have green skin and their green pulp produces a tart, aromatic juice that is used in everything from dressings to desserts. Try squeezing lime juice and sprinkling sea salt over grilled corn on the cob at your next barbeque.

products.name: Naturally Imperfect Limes
products.description: Brighten up your day with the tangy, citrusy taste of Limes. Naturally imperfect, they deliver freshness and quality. They're perfect for making refreshing beverages or adding a zesty punch to your favourite recipes.

products.name: Peaches
products.description: Packaging may differ by region.Peaches range in colour from pinkish-white to reddish-yellow and their flavour can be tart or sweet. If you don't like their fuzzy skin, you can easily peel peaches by blanching them in boiling water for about 30 seconds and then plunging them into ice water. Enjoy peaches as a snack, in a pie, or grilled with prosciutto.

products.name: Yellow Peaches
products.description: Peaches range in colour from pinkish-white to reddish-yellow and their flavour can be tart or sweet. If you don't like their fuzzy skin, you can easily peel peaches by blanching them in boiling water for about 30 seconds and then plunging them into ice water. Enjoy peaches as a snack, in a pie, or grilled with prosciutto.

products.name: Nectarine
products.description: Packaging may differ by region.Nectarines are fragrant and brightly coloured fruit with smooth skin and a firmer flesh than the peach. Nectarines become sweeter as they ripen so avoid those that are too hard or overly green. They are perfect on salads and baked in pies, or grill nectarine halves and serve with ice cream.

products.name: Navel Orange
products.description: Navel oranges are bright orange, easy to peel, and have a sweet and seedless pulp. These popular oranges are an easy snack on the go but can also be used to glaze chicken, duck, and pork.

products.name: Bartlett Pears
products.description: Bartlett pears are bell shaped with smooth yellowish-green skin, often with a hint of red. They are sweet and juicy, the perfect choice for eating fresh as a snack. If you decide to add pears to your next cheese tray, a little lemon juice will keep them from browning once cut.

products.name: Kiwis
products.description: Green kiwis are egg-shaped with fuzzy brown skin. Inside, their green flesh is speckled with tiny black edible seeds and their flavour is sweet and sometimes tart. You can peel and slice your kiwi or just cut it in half and scoop out the flesh. They retain their bright green colour even when exposed to air so kiwi is a good choice for fruit salad and fresh fruit tarts.

products.name: Pineapple
products.description: Pineapples have a diamond-patterned skin that resembles a pinecone with crisp, green leaves shooting out the top. The distinctive flavour of the pineapple's golden yellow flesh is sweet and tangy. Once cut, pineapple makes a great addition to smoothies, or slice yours to make a pineapple upside-down cake.

products.name: Pineapple
products.description: Pineapples have a diamond-patterned skin that resembles a pinecone with crisp, green leaves shooting out the top. The distinctive flavour of the pineapple's golden yellow flesh is sweet and tangy. Once cut, pineapple makes a great addition to smoothies, or slice yours to make a pineapple upside-down cake.

products.name: Apple, Paula Red
products.description: Paula Red apples look similar to McIntosh apples, with bright red skin that is sometimes tinged with green. They have a tart flavour and are a good choice for homemade applesauce, or try slices of Paula Red apples in your next green salad.

products.name: Granny Smith Apples
products.description: Granny Smith apples are bright green and crisp with a tart flavour that is often recommended for pies. Take a Granny Smith apple with you for a snack on the go or add thin slices of apple and crisp bacon to your next grilled cheese sandwich.

products.name: Pink Lady Apples
products.description: Pink Lady apples are a cross between the Golden Delicious and Lady Williams varieties. They have pinkish-red skin and white sweet-tart flesh. Because they resist browning, Pink Lady apples are a good choice for fruit platters, or enjoy them as a fresh snack on the go.

products.name: Fuji Apples
products.description: Fuji apples are a cross between the Red Delicious and Ralls Janet varieties. They are typically red with greenish-yellow stripes and have a sweet flavour. Enjoy Fuji apples fresh as a snack, in your homemade applesauce, or baked with some cinnamon and brown sugar.

products.name: English Cucumber
products.description: English (or hothouse) cucumbers are cylindrical green-skinned vegetable with a crisp white flesh and edible seeds. English cucumbers are typically enjoyed raw and can be peeled or eaten with the skin on. Add sliced cucumber to your next vegetable platter or toss with mint and lemon juice for a refreshing salad.

products.name: Mini Cucumbers
products.description: Mini cucumbers are small versions of the English variety with a bit more crunch. Mini cucumbers are typically enjoyed raw and can eaten with the skin on. Take them with you as a snack on the go or add diced mini cucumbers to your next vegetable platter or salad.

products.name: Field Cucumbers
products.description: Field (or garden) cucumbers are cylindrical green-skinned fruit with a crisp white flesh and edible seeds. Field cucumbers are typically enjoyed raw and peeled to remove the wax coating. Dice yours for salads and salsas, or add slices of cucumber and lemon to a pitcher of water.

products.name: Celery Stalks
products.description: Celery has a cluster of pale green leaved ribs surrounding a heart (inner ribs). Trimmed celery leaves can be used as a garnish or added to a mixed greens salad. Enjoy celery on its own or with dip as a snack, or chop for soups, stews, or a sandwich.

products.name: Bi-Colour Corn, Corn on the Cob
products.description: Bi-colour corn has plump yellow and white kernels in tightly-spaced rows. Corn is covered with a thin layer of golden silk that should be removed prior to cooking. Cook corn and cut the kernels off the cob for salsa, salad, or chili, or boil and serve with butter for classic corn on the cob.

products.name: Green Beans
products.description: There are approximately 7–9 green beans per 25g. Green (or string/snap) beans are long and slender green pods with small edible seeds inside. They are crisp and snap apart when bent. Green beans are easy to prepare and make an excellent side dish. Simply steam or boil the beans until tender-crisp and then toss with light vinaigrette.

products.name: Wax Beans
products.description: There are approximately 2–3 wax beans per 25g. Wax beans are a variety of green bean. They are long and slender pale yellow pods with small edible seeds inside. Wax beans can be used in the same way as green beans. Steam or boil the beans until tender-crisp and then toss with light vinaigrette for a simple side dish.

products.name: Green Onion
products.description: Green onions have a firm white base with a small rounded bulb and crisp bright green tops. Scallions are similar but have a straighter white base and slightly milder flavour. Chop fresh green onions for salads or pair with mushrooms for a tart or omelette.

products.name: Red Onion
products.description: Red (or Italian) onions have a reddish-purple papery skin and a mild sweet flavour. Use red onions to add colour and flavour to just about any dish. Slices of raw red onion work well in salads and as a topping for burgers, or roast and serve with sausage or flank steak.

products.name: Red Onion
products.description: Red (or Italian) onions have a reddish-purple papery skin and a mild sweet flavour. Use red onions to add colour and flavour to just about any dish. Slices of raw red onion work well in salads and as a topping for burgers, or roast and serve with sausage or flank steak.

products.name: Sweet Onion
products.description: Sweet onions include many varieties, the most common of which is the Vidalia onion. Sweet onions have a golden yellow papery skin and white sweet flesh. They are especially good raw in salads and salsas but sweet onions can also be sliced and braised with beef or fried for onion rings.

products.name: White Onion
products.description: White onions have a white papery skin and white sharp-tasting flesh. They can be used raw and hold their crunch well when cooked. Chop for salsas and chutneys, or slice and grill with bell peppers for a quick side dish to serve with steak.

products.name: Yellow Onions, 10 lb bag
products.description: Yellow onions have a light golden skin and a white flesh. These all-purpose onions have a strong flavour and odour and are a very popular choice for cooking. Chop and add to soups, stews, and almost any recipe that calls for onion.

products.name: Sweet Potato
products.description: Sweet potatoes have a thick dark orange skin and sweet orange flesh. Yams are similar in size and shape but are not related to the sweet potato at all. Use sweet potatoes instead of regular potatoes for fries and chips or make a classic sweet potato pie.

products.name: Yellow Potato, 10 lb Bag
products.description: Yellow (or Yukon Gold) potatoes are a waxy potato with golden yellow skin and flesh with a creamy texture that works especially well for mashed potatoes. Thinly slice for scalloped potatoes or chop with carrots and celery for a classic beef stew.

products.name: Baking Russet Potato
products.description: Baking (or russet) potatoes have a rough brown skin and a tender white flesh with a mild flavour. They are a popular variety of potato and a good choice for baking, mashing, and frying. Peel and boil russets for mashed potatoes, or bake whole and top with sour cream for a side dish for your steak or pork chops.

products.name: Red Potatoes, 10 lb Bag
products.description: Red potatoes are a waxy potato with a smooth, reddish skin and a white flesh that holds its shape well when cooked. They have a rich flavour that works well for potato salad, or quarter and roast with olive oil and rosemary.

products.name: White Potatoes
products.description: White potatoes are a waxy potato with a white, freckled-brown skin and a white flesh that holds its shape well when cooked. They have a rich flavour that works well for potato salad, or quarter and roast white potatoes with olive oil and garlic.

products.name: Broccoli Crown
products.description: Broccoli crowns are a versatile and delicious addition to any meal. With their vibrant green colour and unique texture, they can add a refreshing crunch to salads, stir-fries, or roasted vegetable medleys. Broccoli crowns are known for their mild, earthy flavour that pairs well with a variety of seasonings and sauces. Whether you're a seasoned chef or a beginner in the kitchen, incorporating broccoli crowns into your dishes can bring a delightful burst of freshness and contribute to a visually appealing presentation.

products.name: Cabbage, Green
products.description: Cabbages are cruciferous vegetables that range in size, shape, and colour. Green cabbage heads have tightly wrapped leaves with a mild, spicy flavour that can be eaten raw or cooked. Shred cabbage for salad or slaw, or cut into wedges and roast with olive oil and lemon.

products.name: Cauliflower
products.description: Cauliflower is a cruciferous vegetable that comes in a tight cluster of florets surrounded by crisp green leaves. It is normally white but also comes in green, purple, and orange. Add raw cauliflower florets to your next vegetable platter or roast and serve as a simple side dish with meat or fish.

products.name: Broccoli
products.description: Broccoli is a cruciferous vegetable that comes in a tight cluster of florets on top of firm, edible stalks. It is deep green in colour, sometimes with a tinge of purple. Add raw broccoli florets to your next vegetable platter or pair with cheddar cheese for a quiche.

products.name: Lettuce Iceberg
products.description: Iceberg (or crisphead) lettuce is a round, tightly-packed head of pale green leaves. It has a crisp texture and a mild flavour and is mainly used fresh. Shred iceberg lettuce for salads and slaws, or cut into wedges and drizzle with blue cheese dressing.

products.name: Romaine Heart, 3 Pack
products.description: Romaine hearts are the yellowish leaves in the centre of romaine lettuce. Romaine hearts are smaller and sweeter than romaine bunches and can be enjoyed fresh or cooked. Use romaine hearts to make a classic Caesar salad or as a topping for burgers and sandwiches.

products.name: Green Leaf Lettuce
products.description: Green leaf lettuce has loosely bunched leaves that are crisp and full-flavoured. Use green leaf lettuce in your next salad or as a topping for burgers and sandwiches.

products.name: Romaine Lettuce
products.description: Romaine (or Cos) lettuce has dark green, tightly bunched leaves with crunchy white ribs. It has a slightly bitter flavour and can be used fresh or cooked. Use romaine lettuce to make a classic Caesar salad or as a topping for burgers and sandwiches.

products.name: Tomato On The Vine Red (1 Bunch)
products.description: *Average Vine has 3-5 Tomatoes Vine tomatoes are typically sold in clusters attached to a fresh green vine. Because they are a little softer and juicier than other varieties, vine tomatoes are excellent when used fresh in salads, but they can also be roasted or used in many tomato-based recipes.

products.name: Tomato Beefsteak Red
products.description: Greenhouse tomatoes are firm and plump with a red skin when ripe. They are perfect sliced and used as a topping on burgers and sandwiches like the classic BLT. Or scoop out the pulp and seeds to make baked stuffed tomatoes.

products.name: Grape Tomatoes
products.description: Plump, red Grape Tomatoes work well in a variety of dishes. These juicy grape tomatoes are great on their own as a snack or sliced in your favourite salad. Wash well before use.

products.name: Vine Tomato (Single Tomato)
products.description: This vine tomato is a great addition to your cooking essentials. Enhance your salads with fresh slices or create a rich, homemade tomato sauce for your pasta dishes.

products.name: Grape Tomato
products.description: Grape tomatoes are small and oval-shaped with a smooth red or yellow skin. They typically have a thicker skin and sweeter flavour than cherry tomatoes. Add raw grape tomatoes to your salads or vegetable platters, or roast with olive oil and serve with goat cheese and crackers.

products.name: Sweet Green Peppers
products.description: Green bell peppers have a bright green skin and mild, sweet flavour. Their flesh is crisp and juicy, perfect for enjoying raw with dips or hummus. Green bell peppers will add some colour to your stir-fry, or remove the tops and seeds to make stuffed bell peppers.

products.name: Red Peppers
products.description: Red bell peppers start with green skin but are left to ripen longer, giving them their bright red skin and sweet, fruity flavour. Enjoy them raw with dips or hummus, or roast red peppers to make dips and soups or as a topping for burgers and bruschetta.

products.name: Sweet Baby Peppers (4-Pack)
products.description: Bell peppers have green, orange, red, or yellow skin and a sweet flavour. They are crisp and juicy, perfect for enjoying raw with dips or hummus and to add some colour to your stir-fries.

products.name: Naturally Imperfect Mixed Sweet Peppers 2.5lb Bag
products.description: Peppers are a part of the nightshade family and vary in taste form sweet to super-hot. Versatile and healthy, enjoy peppers raw or cooked in a variety of fashions.

products.name: Greenhouse Peppers, Orange
products.description: Orange bell peppers have a bright orange skin and sweet flavour. Their flesh is crisp and juicy, perfect for enjoying raw with dips or hummus. Orange bell peppers will add some colour to your stir-fry and are also perfect for grilling.

products.name: Greenhouse Peppers, Yellow
products.description: Yellow bell peppers have a bright yellow skin and mild, sweet flavour. Their flesh is crisp and juicy, perfect for enjoying raw with dips or hummus. Yellow bell peppers will add some colour to your stir-fry, or remove the tops and seeds to make stuffed bell peppers.

products.name: Ginger
products.description: Ginger (or gingerroot) has a tough tan skin and a fresh spicy fragrance. Ginger can be grated, slivered, or ground and its peppery flavour is used in a variety of dishes. Dried ground ginger has a very different taste and is not a suitable replacement for fresh. Peel gingerroot and add fresh to dressings and marinades, or cook in a stir-fry or soup.

products.name: Garlic Bulbs, 3-count
products.description: Don't forget to add Garlic Bulbs to your weekly shopping list. The pack includes 3 bulbs, so you'll always be prepared when you make soups, stews, pizza, or your favourite stir fry.

products.name: Colossal Fresh Garlic
products.description: Garlic has a plump bulb (or head) of individual cloves each covered with a thin skin that can be peeled. Heads of garlic can be roasted whole and the individual cloves can be crushed, chopped, pressed, puréed, or sliced. Try eating fresh parsley after a meal containing garlic to help control odour.

products.name: Purple Eggplants
products.description: Purple eggplants have glossy, deep purple skin and a meaty texture. Eggplant should only be cut right before use since the flesh discolours quickly. Roast to make eggplant caviar or baba ghanoush, or dice for a classic ratatouille.

products.name: Spinach, Bunched
products.description: Spinach has dark green leaves that are either flat and smooth or curly and crinkled. Both have crisp, fragrant leaves and a slightly bitter flavour. Spinach can be very gritty and must be rinsed thoroughly. Use raw in salad, combine with feta for spanakopita, or sauté in olive oil and garlic for a simple side dish.

products.name: Long Eggplants
products.description: Long (or Japanese) eggplants are small and narrow with deep purple skin. Their flesh is sweeter than the purple eggplant and they are ideal for grilling on the barbeque. You can also chop long eggplants to use in pastas and stews, or stir-fry with garlic and ginger.

products.name: Zucchini
products.description: Zucchini are summer squash with dark to light green skin, white flesh, and tiny edible seeds. They have a delicate flavour and can be eaten raw or cooked in a variety of ways.

products.name: Carrots, 3 lb Bag
products.description: Carrots are long and slender and come in a variety of colours in addition to orange. This popular vegetable is available all year and can be eaten raw or cooked in many ways. Try roasting whole carrots, chopping them for soups, stews, and casseroles, or indulge in carrot cake with cream cheese frosting.

products.name: Mini Carrots
products.description: Baby (or mini) carrots are harvested young and usually very tender and sweet. Because they are already peeled, baby carrots are a quick and easy snack for people of all ages. Enjoy baby carrots on their own, add them to your vegetable platter, or roast them with a little olive oil for an easy side dish.

products.name: Mini Carrots, 2 lb
products.description: Mini (or baby) carrots are harvested young and usually very tender and sweet. Because they are already peeled, baby carrots are a quick and easy snack for people of all ages. Enjoy baby carrots on their own, add them to your vegetable platter, or roast them with a little olive oil for an easy side dish.

products.name: Sweet Nantes Carrots
products.description: These firm and sweet carrots are great for salads, stir-fries, or as a delicious side dish when roasted with herbs and spices. Add a touch of sweetness to your meals with Sweet Nantes Carrots.

products.name: Radishes
products.description: Radishes have a wide range of shapes and colours, from round with red or pink skin to carrot-shaped with white skin. They are crisp with a mild or peppery taste, depending on the variety. Slice raw radishes for salads and sandwiches, or roast whole with butter as a simple side dish.

products.name: Whole White Mushrooms
products.description: Add the mild and delicate flavour of Whole White Mushrooms to a variety of dishes. These versatile mushrooms are great for adding to texture to entrées, including pastas and stir-fries.

products.name: Whole White Mushrooms
products.description: Add the mild and delicate flavour of Whole White Mushrooms to your favourite dishes. These versatile mushrooms are great in entrées or cooked in garlic butter as a savoury side.

products.name: Coleslaw
products.description: Coleslaw is crisp and fresh for a classic taste in every bite. This simple blend of green and red cabbage with carrots is finely cut and ready to use, making it easy to dress up for creamy coleslaw or tangy vinegar-based salads. It’s a convenient choice for family meals, backyard barbecues, entertaining, or meal prep throughout the week.

products.name: Cello Spinach

products.name: Italian Parsley
products.description: Italian (or flat-leaf) parsley is a popular herb with flat, bright green leaves and a stronger, sweeter flavour than curly leaf parsley. Use fresh as a garnish or in salads, or make parsley pesto and serve with pasta, poultry, or vegetables.

products.name: Large Size Eggs 12 Pack
products.description: Large Size Eggs 12 Pack makes everyday cooking and baking easy with a must-have kitchen staple you’ll always reach for. With a rich, satisfying flavour, they’re perfect for fluffy omelettes, baked goods like cakes and muffins, egg sandwiches, or simply fried or poached. This 12 pack keeps you stocked and ready for everything from quick breakfasts to family meals.

products.description: Extra Large Size Eggs 12 Pack are ready to handle everything from quick breakfasts to weekend baking projects.
